prompt:
Build an internal Android accounting application for PAPA SAUCE LAB as a production-oriented mobile-first single-file HTML/CSS/JavaScript app wrapped by the existing ACC Builder Capacitor pipeline. UI language: Indonesian. Do not make a toy calculator. Use an append-only transaction-ledger architecture with durable local persistence via IndexedDB, daily snapshots, audit/correction history, and a Supabase/PostgreSQL cloud-sync adapter/configuration layer. If Supabase credentials are not configured, the app must remain fully usable offline and clearly show CLOUD: NOT CONNECTED; never fake successful cloud backup. Provide Settings fields for Supabase Project URL and publishable/anon key and sync status, plus documented expected table names. Never hardcode service-role secrets.

HARD LOCK ACCOUNTING FORMULAS:
Total Sales = Cash + QRIS + Gojek + Grab.
Total Register = House Bank + Total Sales - Total Out.
On TUTUP HARI, today Total Register MUST automatically become next day's House Bank. This rule is immutable. Example HB 500000 + Sales 700000 - Out 200000 = Register 1000000, therefore next-day HB = 1000000. All amounts derive from ledger transactions; do not let dashboard totals be manually overwritten.

BASELINE / ACCOUNTING PERIOD:
Start first active period with HB=0, Sales=0, Out=0, Register=0, all product stock=0, restock=0. START NEW ACCOUNTING PERIOD is OWNER-only and must archive the old period instead of deleting history, then create a new zero baseline.

DASHBOARD:
Cards: House Bank, Cash, QRIS, Gojek, Grab, Total Sales, Total Out, Total Register, Total Stock. Every numeric card is clickable drill-down showing the exact transactions contributing to that number. Quick buttons: Input Sales, Input Pengeluaran, Restock, Stock Keluar, Laporan, Riwayat, Tutup Hari. Add current accounting date, active period, current user/role, cloud sync state.

SALES LEDGER:
Channels: Cash, QRIS, Gojek, Grab. Each transaction stores immutable id, accounting period id, business date, timestamp, amount, channel, note, input user, created_at, status ACTIVE/CORRECTED, correction linkage. All sales append to permanent ledger.

EXPENSES:
Fields: nama pengeluaran, nominal, kategori, catatan, timestamp, input user. Categories at minimum: bahan baku, packaging, operasional, transport, kebersihan, peralatan, lainnya. Expenses automatically increase Total Out. Raw-material purchases such as Babi 2 kg Rp190.000, Cumi 1 kg Rp90.000, Tongkol 3 kg Rp197.000 are expenses category bahan baku only; never convert them automatically into ready-to-sell product stock.

PRODUCT STOCK:
Initial product catalog exactly: Ayam Woku; Cumi; Tongkol; Babi Rica; Babi Kecap; Sup Brenebone; Sup Grangasem. Stock transaction types: STOCK_IN / RESTOCK and STOCK_OUT. Current product stock = total stock in - total stock out for that product within current period plus its opening snapshot balance. Every movement has date/time, qty (pax/unit), note, input user, immutable ledger id. Total Stock card sums current quantities. Prevent stock out below zero unless OWNER explicitly confirms an override; if overridden, log it in audit trail.

DAILY REPORT:
Allow date picker. Show: House Bank awal, Cash, QRIS, Gojek, Grab, Total Sales, detailed expenses, Total Out, Total Register, stock awal per product, restock per product, stock keluar per product, stock akhir per product, reconciliation, and close-day status. Add Export PDF, Export CSV, and Share WhatsApp. For PDF, provide printable report view and use browser print/share behavior available inside Android WebView; do not label export successful if the platform action fails. CSV must be generated locally and downloadable/shareable.

TUTUP HARI:
OWNER action with confirmation and reconciliation before finalizing. Steps atomically in application logic: 1 save permanent daily report snapshot; 2 save ending stock; 3 bind all day's transactions to snapshot; 4 save final Total Register; 5 create next business-day opening record with House Bank equal to closed day's Total Register. A closed day cannot be silently reopened or overwritten. Corrections after close must create audit entries/adjustment transactions and regenerate a superseding report revision while preserving original snapshot.

DAILY SNAPSHOT:
Persist permanent snapshot with: opening HB, sales by channel and total, all expenses and Total Out, Total Register, opening stock, stock in, stock out, ending stock, reconciliation expected, actual, variance, closed_by, closed_at, snapshot revision. Old dates remain readable forever.

HISTORY:
Search/filter by date and type: sales, expense, stock in, stock out. Timeline examples: 21:30 — OUT — Sunlight — Rp10.000; 20:15 — STOCK OUT — Babi Rica — 3 pax; 18:00 — QRIS — Rp150.000. Add text search and transaction detail page/modal.

AUDIT / CORRECTION:
Never hard-delete a financial or stock transaction. OWNER correction flow: old transaction remains stored, mark status CORRECTED, create linked replacement/adjustment storing old value, new value, reason, timestamp, corrected_by. Audit trail must show who changed what and when. STAFF cannot delete/correct closed reports.

RECONCILIATION:
Input Actual Cash/Register at close. Expected Register = calculated Total Register. Variance = Actual - Expected. Show signed difference prominently, e.g. SELISIH: -Rp50.000. Save variance permanently; never hide or auto-zero it.

ROLES:
Provide simple local session role selector for prototype testing but model data fields for Supabase Auth user id. OWNER: all reports, corrections, export, audit trail, close day, start new period. STAFF: input sales, stock, expenses, view permitted dashboard/history; cannot delete/archive old reports, correct closed transactions, close day, or start period. UI must visibly disable unauthorized actions.

REPORTS:
Daily, Weekly, Monthly. At minimum: omzet, sales per channel, total expenses, raw-material cost, stock movement, ending stock, Total Register. Weekly/monthly totals must be derived from daily ledger/snapshots without double counting.

SUPABASE CLOUD LAYER:
Implement a Settings > Cloud Backup area for Project URL + publishable/anon key, email/password login fields, connection test, sync now, last successful sync, pending local changes counter. Use fetch against Supabase REST/Auth endpoints or a small self-contained adapter; no service-role key. Suggested tables/data model: profiles, accounting_periods, transactions, stock_movements, daily_snapshots, snapshot_stock_lines, audit_events, sync_meta. Store UUID client ids for idempotent upsert. Implement outbound sync queue from IndexedDB and basic pull-by-updated_at. Cloud writes must never erase local ledger history. Clearly surface sync errors. Include an in-app SQL/schema reference section or generated schema text that can be copied to Supabase, with RLS concept: authenticated users scoped to Papa Sauce Lab organization and owner/staff role. Never claim RLS is active until backend is actually configured.

DATA SAFETY:
Use IndexedDB rather than volatile in-memory state. Include manual JSON backup export/import in addition to CSV/PDF. Import must validate schema and never overwrite existing IDs silently; duplicates should be skipped/merged idempotently. No Reset that deletes history.

DESIGN:
Professional internal operations app, fast on Android phones, dark green/cream/gold Papa Sauce Lab feel, strong legibility, compact financial dashboard, bottom navigation for Dashboard / Transaksi / Stock / Laporan / Riwayat, plus Settings via header. Indonesian Rupiah formatting, Asia/Makassar local date/time display, 24-hour clock. Avoid decorative clutter.

ACCEPTANCE CHECKS built into app demo/diagnostics:
A) HB 500000 + Cash 100000 + QRIS 200000 + Gojek 250000 + Grab 150000 - Out 200000 => Total Sales 700000 and Total Register 1000000.
B) Close day => next day's House Bank exactly 1000000.
C) Correcting a Rp100000 QRIS entry to Rp150000 preserves old entry as CORRECTED and new active value 150000.
D) Stock Babi Rica in 10, out 3 => current 7.
E) Actual register 950000 vs expected 1000000 => variance -50000.
F) START NEW ACCOUNTING PERIOD creates zero baseline while archived old period/report/history remain readable.

Generate apps/papa-sauce-lab/index.html and project.json, with no dependency on unavailable backend credentials for core offline accounting. Ensure all buttons are actually wired and no placeholder buttons remain for core features.
